_readme: Camp object of each profession (the one you place from skill 20, taught by the trainer) and its upgrades. Facts from classicwowforever.com/professions/camping/objects/ (beta build 70245), reworded and cited.

effect.es: Maná cada 5 s: 10 a 29 según tu nivel. No se suma con Blessing of Wisdom.
effect.en: Mana every 5 sec: 10 to 29 by your level. Doesn't stack with Blessing of Wisdom.

effect.es: Fuerza: 6 a 34 según tu nivel. No se suma con Strength of Earth Totem.
effect.en: Strength: 6 to 34 by your level. Doesn't stack with Strength of Earth Totem.

effect.es: Armadura, todos los atributos (2 a 13) y resistencias según tu nivel. No se suma con Mark of the Wild.
effect.en: Armor, all attributes (2 to 13) and resistances by your level. Doesn't stack with Mark of the Wild.

effect.es: Vende componentes. El Repair Bot (140) además repara el equipo.
effect.en: Sells reagents. The Repair Bot (140) also repairs gear.

effect.es: Intelecto: 2 a 25 según tu nivel. No se suma con Arcane Intellect.
effect.en: Intellect: 2 to 25 by your level. Doesn't stack with Arcane Intellect.

effect.es: Completa la experiencia descansada hasta 5% de un nivel (una vez por hora).
effect.en: Tops rested experience up to 5% of a level (once an hour).

effect.es: Poder de ataque cuerpo a cuerpo: 12 a 90 según tu nivel. No se suma con Blessing of Might.
effect.en: Melee attack power: 12 to 90 by your level. Doesn't stack with Blessing of Might.

effect.es: +2% de crítico para ataques y hechizos. No se suma con Moonkin Aura.
effect.en: +2% critical chance for attacks and spells. Doesn't stack with Moonkin Aura.

effect.es: Espíritu para los de tu facción cerca: 14 a 32 según tu nivel. No se suma con Divine Spirit.
effect.en: Spirit for nearby members of your faction: 14 to 32 by your level. Doesn't stack with Divine Spirit.

effect.es: Aguante: 3 a 56 según tu nivel. No se suma con Power Word: Fortitude.
effect.en: Stamina: 3 to 56 by your level. Doesn't stack with Power Word: Fortitude.

effect.es: +8% a todos los atributos, también para los que no pescan. No se suma con Blessing of Kings.
effect.en: +8% to all attributes, also for those who don't fish. Doesn't stack with Blessing of Kings.

effect.es: La base de todo campamento (3 objetos; 5 con Cocina 140 y 10 con 220). Cookie's Feast (140) sirve comida de Aguante; el Iron Oven (300) habilita recetas avanzadas.
effect.en: The base of every camp (3 objects; 5 at Cooking 140 and 10 at 220). Cookie's Feast (140) lays out Stamina food; the Iron Oven (300) enables advanced recipes.
